title: Asking and clarifying
lead: Is lesson ke baad tum client ke fast English, unclear requirement ya bad phone audio me bhi ruk kar politely repeat, meaning aur permission maang paoge.
description: Week 3 English lesson: ask for repetition, check meaning, request explanations, and ask permission politely.

patterns.note: Please add karo; tone polite rehta hai.
patterns.negative: Sorry, I can't hear you clearly.
patterns.question: Can you repeat that, please?
examples: Can you repeat the last part, please?
Kya aap last part dobara bata sakte hain?
Could you speak a little more slowly?
Kya aap thoda dheere bol sakte hain?
patterns.grammar: Can/Could + subject + base verb. Could zyada polite. Please sentence ke end me — tone soft rehta hai.
patterns.mistake: “Can you repeat?” → “Can you repeat that, please?” That se clear hota hai kya repeat karna hai.

patterns.note: Word ya phrase ka meaning puchhne ke liye.
patterns.say: What do you mean by scope?
patterns.positive: What do you mean by scope?
patterns.negative: I don't know what you mean.
patterns.question: What do you mean by scope?
examples: What do you mean by 'by Friday'?
‘Friday tak’ se aapka matlab kya hai?
Do you mean this week or next week?
Aapka matlab is hafte ya agle hafte?
patterns.grammar: mean by + noun/phrase. Confirm karne ke liye: Do you mean this week or next week?
patterns.mistake: “What you mean?” → “What do you mean?” Question me do chahiye.

patterns.note: Explain ke baad kya explain karna hai, woh bolo.
patterns.say: Could you explain the payment process?
patterns.positive: Could you explain the payment process?
patterns.negative: I don't understand the payment process.
patterns.question: Could you explain the payment process?
examples: Could you explain the timeline?
Kya aap timeline samjha sakte hain?
Could you explain it in simple words?
Kya aap ise simple shabdon me samjha sakte hain?
patterns.grammar: explain + thing. Person ke liye to: Could you explain it to me? ‘Explain me’ galat hai.
patterns.mistake: “Could you explain me?” → “Could you explain it to me?” Explain + thing + to + person.

patterns.say: Is it okay if I call you after lunch?
patterns.positive: Is it okay if I call you after lunch?
patterns.negative: Is it okay if I don't join the call?
patterns.question: Is it okay if I call you after lunch?
examples: Is it okay if I send it tomorrow?
Kya main ise kal bhej sakta hoon?
Is it okay if we meet at four?
Kya hum chaar baje mil sakte hain?
patterns.grammar: Is it okay if + subject + present simple. Future ke liye will nahi lagta.
patterns.mistake: “Is it okay if I will call?” → “Is it okay if I call?” If clause me present simple.

patterns.note: Samajh nahi aaya ya sunai nahi diya — dono ke liye.
patterns.negative: I didn't catch the last word.
patterns.question: Sorry, could you say that again?
examples: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
Sorry, aapka naam nahi suna.
I didn't catch the last sentence.
Aakhri sentence samajh nahi aaya.
patterns.grammar: didn't + base verb. catch = sunna/samajhna. Past negative me didn't catch.
patterns.mistake: “I didn't caught that.” → “I didn't catch that.” didn't ke baad base verb.

patterns.frame: How do you say ___ in English?
patterns.note: Hindi word ka English puchhne ke liye.
patterns.say: How do you say jaldi in English?
patterns.positive: How do you say jaldi in English?
patterns.negative: I don't know the English word for this.
patterns.question: How do you say this in English?
examples: How do you say this word in English?
Is word ko English me kya kehte hain?
How do you spell the domain name?
Domain name ki spelling kaise likhte hain?
patterns.grammar: How do you say + word + in English? Spelling ke liye: How do you spell it?
patterns.mistake: “How to say this in English?” → “How do you say this in English?” Question me do you.

grammarRules: Can you repeat that? Could you explain it?
Could you explain + thing (+ to me)
Could you explain the process to me?
Is it okay if + subject + present simple
Is it okay if I call you later?
What do you mean by scope?
How do you say this in English?
mistakes: Could you explain it to me?
Is it okay if I will call?
Is it okay if I call?
How to say this in English?
How do you say this in English?
That + please se request clear aur polite hoti hai.

dialogue.context: Client call, audio thoda unclear. Riya = client. Har line me ek clarifying question hai.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: So we need the new page by Friday.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Can you repeat the date, please?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. And what do you mean by new page — the design or the content?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Got it. Could you share the reference site?

dialogue.closing: Clarify karna stupid nahi lagta. Galat kaam karna lagta hai.

speakPrompts.title: 1. Ask for repetition
speakPrompts.prompt: Client fast bol raha hai. Do lines bolo.
speakPrompts.starter: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Can you repeat that, please?

speakPrompts.title: 2. Check meaning
speakPrompts.prompt: Ek word ka meaning confirm karo.
speakPrompts.starter: What do you mean by ___ ? Do you mean ___ or ___ ?

speakPrompts.title: 3. Ask permission
speakPrompts.starter: Is it okay if I ___ ? Could you explain ___ ?

speakPrompts.title: 4. Phone-call rescue
speakPrompts.prompt: Char lines ka rescue script record karo.
speakPrompts.starter: Sorry, the audio is not clear. Can you repeat that? ... Thank you. Could you explain ___ ?

vocab.example: What do you mean by scope?
I'd like to clarify one point.
Could you explain it in detail?
Can you check the spelling of the domain?
I want to confirm the deadline.

selfCheck: Repetition maangne ke liye Can/Could + please use kiya.
Ek word ka meaning “What do you mean by ___?” se poochha.
“Could you explain ___?” me explain ke baad thing boli.
Permission ke liye “Is it okay if I ___?” use kiya.
“I didn't catch that” bina jhijhak boli.
Polite tone raha, demand jaisa nahi laga.

pronunciation.title: Yes/No question intonation
pronunciation.body: Can you REpeat that? — end me voice upar. Request ko soft banata hai.

pronunciation.title: Wh- question intonation
pronunciation.body: WHAT do you MEAN by SCOPE? — end me voice neeche. Stress meaning par.

pronunciation.title: didn't catch
pronunciation.body: didn't = /ˈdɪdənt/, catch = /kætʃ/. Linking: “didn't catch” ek saath bolo, dono ko alag alag mat toda karo.

followUps: Client call me repeat maangna rude lagta hai kya?
“What do you mean by scope?” ka aur natural version kya hai?
Meri “Could you explain” line me tone polite thi?
Phone par audio clear karne ke liye aur kaunse phrases use karun?
“I didn't catch that” ke baad kya bolna chahiye?
mission: Ek asli client ya colleague se English me ek clarifying question poochho — repeat, meaning, ya permission.
